name: Astro
metaTitle: Astro Website Development for Speed and SEO
description: Techlio engineers ultra-fast, zero-bloat marketing and content platforms with Astro, optimized for Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, and AI search crawlability.
h1: Marketing and content sites *that load fast and get found.*
answer: Astro is a web framework that ships pages as plain HTML with very little JavaScript, which makes sites fast and easy for search engines and AI crawlers to read. Techlio builds marketing and content platforms on it with an editor for non-technical teams. This website is built on Astro.

builds.title: Marketing and content sites

builds.title: Editor-friendly content
builds.text: A content panel where your team edits pages and publishes articles without a developer.

builds.title: SEO and AI search foundations
builds.text: Sitemaps, schema markup, llms.txt and crawler rules set up from the start.

faqs.question: Can non-developers edit an Astro site?
faqs.answer: Yes. We add a content panel so pages, case studies and articles are edited in forms.

faqs.question: Is Astro suitable for a web application?
faqs.answer: It is best for content-led sites. For application-style products we use React and Next.js.
